lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five parallel horizontal rows. A localized area of higher spatial density is visible immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit, with spots becoming more linearly aligned and widely spaced as they progress posteriorly.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like configuration where the spots serve as high-intensity nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal carinae are visible on the upper lateral flank, each defined by a distinct linear intensity gradient consisting of a high-luminance superior edge and a pronounced shadow on the inferior side.

other_distinctive_markers: The right pectoral fin in the foreground displays a high density of small, high-luminance spots, with a notable increase in density and decrease in spot diameter toward the distal tip.
